render-spend-trajectory.ref: 2026-10-10 reel quality upgrade. reelPipeline.ts is touched in ONE place, the enqueue preflight, where a brief's heroAssetId is verified read-only (resolveHeroStill) and, if bindable, written onto brief.visualWorld BEFORE the reservation block; nothing on the spend path moves. The reservation itself now prices the model that will be billed: generationLedger.reelClipCostUsd reads REEL_CLIP_MODEL (seedance_2_5 and kling at 0.55 USD est. vs 0.25 for seedance1_5), so switching the model can only RAISE the reserved estimate, never under-reserve; pinned by server/reelSourceAware.test.ts 'clip model follows REEL_CLIP_MODEL, and so does the reservation price' and server/mediaModelRegistry.test.ts (self_hosted pricing untouched). The CLI lane sends the same request shape with only the model id swapped (buildSeedanceArgs; server/imageConditioning.test.ts: resolution/aspect/duration flags unchanged, non-allowlisted ids never reach the CLI). externalMasterFinish is local ffmpeg only, no provider call. No new paid call is added anywhere; the one approved Seedance 2.5 test reel is enqueued by an operator-run script (scripts/enqueue-quality-test-reel.mts, dry run default) through the normal enqueueReelJob reservation.
